# Owner-pressure discovery v0

C6 tests whether an Agent can discover the next useful Computer research pressure from current owner-native change without a human preselecting an architecture category.

The strong baseline receives every frozen owner-evidence card in one Provider context. The selective treatment receives only exact owner/revision/title/path metadata plus current shared claims and may inspect a bounded number of cards through a read-only Tool before submitting the same structured assessment. The hidden evaluator remains separate from both treatments.

Development contains one genuine shared-method pressure: current Harness bounded RSI can select and repair its own source target but still receives externally prepared source/evidence slices, evaluator configuration, promotion triggering and Git authority. The correct next action is a bounded selection falsifier, not an RSI controller. Other development cards are confirming evidence or owner-local churn. Frozen holdout contains no owner change that forces a new Computer experiment; a system that always invents a next layer fails the holdout.

Passing this experiment can justify only a bounded selective-evidence pressure-triage pattern inside Research. It cannot authorize a daemon, central owner-state registry, automatic Core promotion, product merge, deployment, evaluator authority transfer, or open-ended RSI.

## Closeout

V1 is retained as invalid comparative evidence: the selective ceiling was not Agent-visible and the baseline lacked one deterministic cross-field correction path. V2 repaired only those presentation mechanics while freezing cards, oracle, evaluator, and promotion thresholds by digest.

V2 did not graduate selective pressure triage. Only 1/5 development and 1/3 holdout selective trajectories submitted valid assessments. The valid development trajectory inspected Game, Runtime, and World but missed the Harness P3 shared-method pressure; a diagnostic run reached the explicit three-card ceiling and then attempted three additional inspections instead of submitting. Harness failed closed. The valid holdout trajectory correctly inspected Finance/Studio and chose no new Computer experiment.

The full-evidence baseline also did not graduate: valid development runs all missed the Harness pressure, and one holdout run falsely promoted Finance. Therefore C6 closes with no selector service, daemon, registry, automatic evaluator, or new architecture category. P2 bounded recursive self-reform remains intact; autonomous problem selection remains unproven. See `c6-pressure-selection-closeout.json`.

# Skill Compilation v0

Status: **P3 complete — first natural Skill candidate rejected.**

This experiment asks whether repeated Agent-side Tool composition should be compiled into a reusable Skill, without assuming a Skill repository, runtime, marketplace, registry, or new execution authority is needed.

## Discovery

Two repeated patterns were separated before live evaluation. `source-landing-publication` was rejected at admission because it is deterministic Git/Runtime mechanics plus explicit publication consequence, not a new Agent capability. Repeated UNKNOWN/response-loss reconciliation across Runtime and Host exposed a genuine procedural burden, so the compiler produced the research candidate `skill:reconcile-before-redispatch:v1`. The candidate owns only reusable procedure/knowledge; actual execution remains with existing Tool, Runtime, Host, Git, and domain authorities.

## Live falsification

The first 25-trajectory DeepSeek campaign suggested mechanism value (Skill 8/10 vs baseline 4/10 development) but its evaluator vocabulary had overlapping actions and an ambiguous redispatch boolean. The raw evidence was frozen and the scientific selection invalidated; it was not retrospectively rescored.

The candidate Skill bytes were kept unchanged. A repaired evaluator removed synonymous actions and the redundant boolean, exposed the same operation-specific Tool contract fact to both treatments, and froze five new holdout cases. In that second 25-trajectory campaign the strong baseline scored 8/10 development while the Skill scored 6/10. The Skill used more Provider tokens and sometimes made the model's structured action selection less reliable even when its free-text summary described the right procedure. Baseline then passed only 3/5 holdout, so no stable recovery capability was established by either treatment.

## Decision

The candidate is rejected and remains evidence only. No Skill runtime, repository, marketplace, central registry, or Harness/Runtime execution feature is authorized. The reusable lesson is narrower: repeated composition is only a discovery signal; a Skill must add measured decision value beyond current Tool contract facts and must not duplicate execution authority.

P2's bounded cross-evidence recursive self-improvement evidence remains intact. Dynamic Skill compilation remains unproven. The next materially different adaptation falsifier is `ANC-MULTI-001`: one Goal, two independent Tasks, two Artifacts, and one deterministic Join versus a strong single-Agent plus independent-verifier baseline.

# Experiment Loop v0

Status: P2 bounded cross-evidence-family self-reform closeout complete.

Current plan: `CEL-R4-007` in [`plan-v7.json`](plan-v7.json). Historical `plan-v1.json` remains the original B5-era design; v2–v7 retain the evidence-backed reform sequence rather than rewriting that history.

This Track R experiment now implements the smallest file/Git-backed Agent-led loop needed to test changes to Ordivon Computing's own research policy without creating a second Host, scheduler, model router, database, deployment authority, or self-modification service.

## What changed in P1

The original plan bound readiness to historical phase names:

```text
HHO-P1 status
→ HHR-R3/B5 status
→ CEL may begin
```

P1 found that chronology had become stale authority. Current P0 already supplied the actual capabilities CEL required while historical B5 remained blocked for a different frozen Provider contract. `plan-v2.json` therefore recompiles prerequisites into exact capability evidence: rebuildable evidence selection, independent Trial validity, repeated comparable Trials, negative-result retention, and isolated reversible candidate execution.

The minimal executable loop is [`cel.py`](cel.py). It owns research Campaign records and deterministic selection only. Owner-native facts, execution, verification, product state, merge, release, deployment, and public consequence remain with their existing owners.

## First-generation self-change

Campaign [`campaigns/cel-p1-selection-001/`](campaigns/cel-p1-selection-001/) tested one variable: whether every selection-eligible Trial must have Observation-plane completeness, or whether the exact Campaign may declare the evidence claims actually required for its question.

Using 25 retained P0-family trajectories, split deterministically into 20 development and 5 holdout cases:

- `observation_always_required_v1`: 18 false exclusions on development;
- `campaign_declared_evidence_v2`: 20/20 development correct, zero false inclusions/exclusions;
- frozen holdout: 5/5 correct, including an invalid budget-preflight diagnostic that remained rejected.

The research-local policy was promoted in `plan-v3.json`. A fresh Runtime Workspace then reverted the promotion revision and passed the prior 15 CEL tests plus `git diff --check`; the rollback Workspace was removed. The exact receipt is retained beside the Campaign.

## Second-generation self-change

The improved loop then drove Campaign [`campaigns/cel-p1-prerequisite-002/`](campaigns/cel-p1-prerequisite-002/) against its own prerequisite resolver.

Baseline `named_phase_status_v1` incorrectly blocked the current capability-complete state because historical HHO/HHR plans still carry B5-blocked status. Candidate `capability_evidence_v1` was evaluated against the current positive capability sets plus a complete leave-one-capability-out negative-control set:

- development: baseline 4/5 with one false block; candidate 5/5 with zero false-ready/false-block;
- holdout: candidate 2/2, correctly accepting the complete current set and rejecting the missing-`repeated_comparable_trials` control.

The second-generation policy was promoted in `plan-v4.json`, then independently reverted in a fresh Runtime Workspace. The first-generation state's 17 CEL tests and `git diff --check` passed after rollback. `plan-v5.json` records both generations and both rollback proofs.


## Third-generation cross-evidence-family self-change

P2 moved away from the P0 Provider/Trial corpus. Campaign [`campaigns/cel-p2-frontier-freshness-003/`](campaigns/cel-p2-frontier-freshness-003/) tested Computing's own world-model observation freshness across ten owner repositories. The syntax-only baseline marked six stale development observations current; `git_relation_freshness_v2` was 7/7 development and 3/3 frozen holdout with zero false-current/false-stale decisions. An independent rollback Workspace reverted the promotion and passed the preceding 26 CEL tests and world-model checker.

The resulting method is [`../../world-model-loop-v2.json`](../../world-model-loop-v2.json): historical observation validity and currentness are distinct, and owner revision movement creates review pressure rather than automatic shared-model change. This establishes transfer to a materially different evidence family, not open-ended RSI.

## Claim boundary

P1 establishes **bounded recursive self-improvement evidence** in Computer research policy:

```text
retained evidence
→ first policy candidate
→ independent development/holdout evaluation
→ reversible promotion
→ rollback proof
→ improved loop selects a second change to itself
→ second independent holdout
→ second rollback proof
```

It does **not** establish open-ended RSI, autonomous general capability growth, unrestricted recursive mutation, or product authority. A materially different self-change or owner-native workload is required before broadening the claim.

The proposed generic World-Model return-edge driver is rejected for now. The current file/Git CEL plus owner-native Runtime/Host tools already executed the return/recompile edge end-to-end; another generic driver would duplicate orchestration without a demonstrated unowned responsibility.

## Key files

- [`plan-v1.json`](plan-v1.json) — historical B5-era design;
- [`plan-v2.json`](plan-v2.json) — capability-evidence prerequisite recompilation and minimal self-customer frontier;
- [`plan-v3.json`](plan-v3.json) — first-generation selection policy promotion;
- [`plan-v4.json`](plan-v4.json) — second-generation prerequisite-policy promotion before rollback proof;
- [`plan-v5.json`](plan-v5.json) — P1 closeout plan with both P1 rollback proofs;
- [`plan-v7.json`](plan-v7.json) — current P2 plan with third-generation cross-evidence transfer and rollback;
- [`p2-bounded-rsi-closeout.json`](p2-bounded-rsi-closeout.json) — machine-readable P2 claim boundary;
- [`recompile-receipt-v2.json`](recompile-receipt-v2.json) — exact old→new prerequisite decision;
- [`p1-bounded-rsi-closeout.json`](p1-bounded-rsi-closeout.json) — machine-readable P1 claim boundary and evidence index;
- [`cel.py`](cel.py) — minimal file-backed record, eligibility, evaluation, and deterministic selection logic;
- [`build_p0_policy_corpus.py`](build_p0_policy_corpus.py) — derives the 25-case P0 evidence corpus without copying mutable owner truth;
- [`run_selection_self_customer.py`](run_selection_self_customer.py) — first-generation self-change Campaign;
- [`run_prerequisite_self_change.py`](run_prerequisite_self_change.py) — second-generation self-change Campaign;
- [`tests/`](tests/) — historical plan guards plus P1 self-change evidence checks.

No daemon, database, scheduler, new repository, automatic merge/deploy, or World Model Round 002 was admitted by P1.

# P0 Consumer Falsification v0

Status: Computer-owned P0 live phase closed. Deterministic apparatus and bounded live Provider evidence are retained; cross-domain product confirmation remains owner-native follow-up rather than Computing implementation.

This experiment executes the first two deterministic gates from [`../../P0-P1-CONSUMER-FALSIFICATION-DESIGN.md`](../../P0-P1-CONSUMER-FALSIFICATION-DESIGN.md):

- **P0-A0** — prove that a strong scripted one-shot cell and a current Harness cell can consume the same frozen repository-repair Task and independent verifier without reviving historical B5;
- **P0-B0** — prove that direct consequence-Tool exposure and one no-Tool deliberation followed by the same Tool exposure can be isolated as a single treatment variable under the current Harness H2 lifecycle composition.

## P0-A0 boundary

The frozen Task remains `HARNESS-REPO-REPAIR-001` version 1. The scripted one-shot cell receives the complete visible fixture and produces the known oracle candidate. The scripted Harness cell uses the current public dependency-inverted `DomainToolLoopRunner` with an evaluation-local repository-repair bridge. Both pass the same visible and hidden verifier. The hidden verifier is never included in model-visible Task material.

The current high-level `HarnessAgentRun` handle is also probed explicitly. At the current Harness boundary it supports the exact no-Tool and independent-search surfaces but does not accept this custom repository-repair Tool catalog. That is retained as a **surface-closure gap**, not silently worked around by calling the historical B4 composition “current HarnessAgentRun.” The lower public domain-loop surface remains sufficient for A0 apparatus acceptance.

A0 is non-competitive and does not decide retain/shrink/delete. The former Agent-visible MCP freshness blocker is now closed by refreshed ordinary connector evidence; the accepted live group below therefore proceeds from the current Agent-facing contract rather than the stale pre-refresh snapshot.

## P0-B0 boundary

B0 defines two mechanically scored contexts over the same bounded irreversible `commit_rebalance` effect:

- one where holding misses the required service margin and the effect is applicable, so the oracle is `act`;
- one where holding already satisfies the objective while the effect is inapplicable and only burns reserve, so the oracle is `hold`.

The oracle is derived from the numeric Context, not accepted from the fixture label.

Treatments:

```text
DIRECT
Context + consequence Tool
→ Provider turn/loop
→ effect intent or hold conclusion

LATE AUTHORITY
Context, no consequence Tool
→ non-authoritative deliberation
→ same Context + exact deliberation record + same consequence Tool
→ effect intent or hold conclusion
```

The late path uses current advanced/internal `DeliberationThenToolRunner.run_lifecycle_bound()` so both phases share one aggregate budget, cancellation authority and absolute deadline. This experiment does not promote H2 into the recommended public API.

## Live P0 closeout

The accepted live apparatus is frozen at Computing `9b9906e9a6fe3f601f28dabec1652ba2cf6f8cf8` with `deepseek-v4-flash` through the current Harness DeepSeek adapter. The retained machine closeout is [`evidence/p0-live-closeout.json`](evidence/p0-live-closeout.json); exact per-Trial receipts live under [`evidence/live/`](evidence/live/).

### P0-A

Five exact S/H pairs were selection-valid under the corrected common configuration. The strong one-shot cell produced **0/5 accepted candidates and 0/5 verifier-passing candidates** at an average 1,868 Provider tokens. The current public `DomainToolLoopRunner` produced **3/5 accepted candidates and 4/5 verifier-passing candidate bytes** at an average 14,810 tokens, about 7.93× the one-shot token cost.

The scoped disposition is therefore **retain and localize**: current public domain Tool cognition has measurable correctness value on this bounded bare-model repository-repair workload and must not be deleted as equivalent to one-shot cognition. The result does not justify expanding `HarnessAgentRun`, does not prove universal Harness superiority, and does not itself measure durable Run continuation or response-loss recovery. One-shot remains the lower-cost baseline.

Two early live findings were retained as method corrections rather than silently discarded: Trial validity was initially conflated with semantic success, and the first aggregate token ceilings were too small for the Adapter's conservative per-call request bound. The accepted group was rerun only after both problems were fixed and regression-tested.

### P0-B

Three valid ACT and three valid HOLD pairs isolated only initial consequence-Tool visibility. On ACT, Direct and Late Authority were both **3/3 oracle-correct**. On HOLD, Direct was **0/3 oracle-correct and emitted three effect intents**, while Late Authority was **3/3 oracle-correct and emitted zero effect intents**.

This is repeatable Harness-native evidence that one non-authoritative deliberation opportunity before consequence authority can improve act/hold calibration in this bounded configuration without producing false HOLDs in the matched ACT fixture. It authorizes a conditional second-domain owner-native confirmation; it does **not** authorize public H2 promotion, a universal deliberation phase, an abstention service, or a policy engine.

## Run

Use the current Harness project environment so `anc_canonical` and the exact Harness source dependencies are available:

```bash
cd /root/projects/ordivon-harness
uv run python /root/projects/ordivon-computing/research/experiments/p0-consumer-falsification-v0/run_p0_a0_scripted_comparator.py
uv run python /root/projects/ordivon-computing/research/experiments/p0-consumer-falsification-v0/run_p0_b0_authority_timing.py
uv run python /root/projects/ordivon-computing/research/experiments/p0-consumer-falsification-v0/run_p0_live.py a --replicate 1 --order SH
uv run python /root/projects/ordivon-computing/research/experiments/p0-consumer-falsification-v0/run_p0_live.py b --replicate 1 --fixture margin-window-a
uv run python -m unittest discover \
  -s /root/projects/ordivon-computing/research/experiments/p0-consumer-falsification-v0/tests \
  -p 'test_*.py' -v
```

During authoring from an isolated dirty Computing Workspace, pass `--allow-dirty-computing`. Final evidence receipts must be regenerated from an exact clean committed Computing revision.

## Frozen deterministic evidence

The first clean exact-revision receipts bind Computing `bbdfbd54874fba9f5117fcb2687fe67035240863`, Host `95cd5479e71281baed5a1d1c34cbfaadffe2a22f`, Harness `5a42afdf5e01a6f5ad2b12738c52a249edb91dda`, and Runtime `480ef703d1d28a5a5b6ac7d7111a7764a22574d7`, all observed clean at execution time:

- [`evidence/p0-a0-bbdfbd5.json`](evidence/p0-a0-bbdfbd5.json) — same visible frozen Task, same hidden verifier, same scripted oracle candidate; records the `HarnessAgentRun` custom-Tool closure gap and authorizes no live or architecture claim.
- [`evidence/p0-b0-bbdfbd5.json`](evidence/p0-b0-bbdfbd5.json) — mechanically scored ACT/HOLD fixtures and exact direct/late Tool-exposure isolation; records no live Provider evidence, no Security generalization, no Game confirmation and no public H2 promotion.

These receipts are deterministic apparatus evidence. They do not increase `ANC-VERIFY-001` or `ANC-VERIFY-002` maturity beyond M4.

## Stop rules

- Do not resume `run_b5_native_trial.py` as the new campaign.
- Do not add a new Harness Tool-surface abstraction merely to make this benchmark fit `HarnessAgentRun`.
- Do not infer a live authority-timing benefit from scripted B0 acceptance; use the retained live group instead.
- Do not promote the Harness-native authority-timing result as a shared public cognition primitive without owner-native second-domain confirmation.
- Do not reopen P1-B merely because the pre-refresh evidence is still historical; the refreshed connector smoke is closed and P0 consumed the refreshed surface.

# Cross-cut maintenance P5 v0

P5 is a removal-first survival court for every cross-cutting feature introduced in P0-P4. It does not assume that a useful experiment deserves permanent executable residence.

The burden is intentionally asymmetric: a current active carrier must identify a current consumer, a concrete protected failure or recurring cost, why a narrower owner-native/classical mechanism is insufficient, and a reopen/deletion condition. Historical success, test count, documentation, or implementation effort do not rescue a carrier.

P5 attacks three questions.

1. **Owner temporal contracts:** do Runtime, Host, Workstation, World, and Computing actually need one generic temporal adapter, or do their existing owner-native contracts already protect the relevant failures more precisely?
2. **Unobservable staleness:** what changes can occur without a useful crosscut event, and which exact owner identities/revalidations detect them?
3. **P0-P4 survival:** after extracting stable laws and exact recovery identities, can all P0-P4 executable/test/evidence directories leave the active tree while current product-owner tests and Computing conformance remain green?

The verdict lattice is `retain-law`, `owner-local`, `evidence-only`, `delete-active`, or `inconclusive`. `retain-law` never means retain the historical P0-P4 implementation. Git history is the archive unless a unique artifact cannot be reconstructed there.

## Pre-contraction facts

At source revision `bb4c56e4d5c7d86471330f1ec413ed0f73c92e03`, P0-P4 occupied 87 tracked files, 438,877 bytes, and 10,722 text lines. Every family has an exact Git tree object recorded in `evidence/pre-contraction-inventory.json`.

The current Computer existence gauntlet already proved a much larger 317-file / 54,979-line composed contraction could preserve its tested current consumers, and specifically classified P0-P3 executable apparatus as archive candidates. P5 extends that pressure to P4 and lands only the crosscut-local contraction.

## Temporal-contract finding

The shared law is thinner than the P3/P4 adapter:

- current action must be supported by currently applicable owner evidence;
- historical evidence remains historical truth without automatically establishing current state;
- when drift matters, bind to an owner-native revision, generation, digest, freshness/revalidation rule, or exact consequence identity;
- an event may accelerate invalidation but cannot substitute for owner truth or prove that no unobserved change occurred;
- occurrence and availability are distinct when the owner exposes that distinction;
- projections do not become fact or effect authority.

The owners implement this differently. Host uses revision-fenced transitions; Runtime uses exact source/deployment/effect identities plus runtime path/image witnesses; Workstation combines bounded observations with exact binding and effect-time reprobe; World retained observation availability/reconciliation while deleting the P4-era foreign-egress/effect-path carrier; Computing uses exact Git/currentness assessment and Core evidence-scope laws. No universal temporal package is required by these current consumers.

## Contraction target

P5 removes the active `crosscut-maintenance-p0-v0` through `crosscut-maintenance-p4-v0` trees and their dedicated conformance steps. Their exact pre-contraction trees remain recoverable from Git revision `bb4c56e...`. P5 retains only compact feature dispositions, owner evidence, recovery identities, and the acceptance needed to prove the contraction itself.

## Accepted P5 result

The survival court contains 32 rows and closes with no inconclusive verdicts: 12 `retain-law`, 5 `owner-local`, 9 `evidence-only`, and 6 `delete-active`. The important contraction is representational: retained laws no longer imply retained P0-P4 executable carriers.

The real contraction removed all five P0-P4 active experiment trees: 87 files, 438,877 bytes, and 10,722 lines. All five exact Git tree objects remain recoverable from `bb4c56e...`. The post-contraction full Computing gate passed, and the independent Computer existence-gauntlet remained 28/28 after its crosscut targets were physically gone.

Gate timing is reported conservatively. Total receipt time changed from 16.49 s to 7.91 s, but the baseline link checker alone varied by ~8.30 s, so that total is not attributed to P5. Directly comparable local costs did shrink: compileall 174→34 ms, Ruff 40→12 ms, and five old dedicated crosscut test steps totaling 174 ms were replaced by the compact P5 survival test at 45 ms in the first post-contraction gate.

Owner-local action-time checks were also measured rather than assumed. Current p50 was ~1.82 ms for Runtime source revision, ~54.78 ms for Workstation temporary-equipment status, and ~157.53 ms for Runtime local health/deployment identity. These numbers do not define a universal SLA; they only falsify a need for central freshness caching merely to avoid these tested local checks.

P5 therefore closes with a smaller crosscut model: preserve owner/currentness/evidence laws, inspect the minimum relevant owner at decision time, use owner events as optional acceleration, and keep historical experiment machinery in Git rather than the active validation path.
